purpose: What pictures show, as vectors in one space with texts (user 2026-11-10: sorting the B-roll by content, offline), as a plug-in program. Version 2 (docs/102 step 5): the request carries the pictures themselves and names the model; the program finds the model in the AI catalog of the computer it runs on. Nothing falls back to another engine.
transport: The JSON lines of qnc.module.plugin-process: the application's hello, the plug-in's ready, then one request at a time.

pictures.body: { model, pictures: [jpeg] }: model is a model's name (its file or folder name); each picture is a JPEG as base64
pictures.ok: { vectors: [[number]] }: one unit vector a picture, in the order given

texts.ok: { vectors: [[number]], scale, bias }: one unit vector a text; a text describes a picture by the sigmoid of cosine * scale + bias

rules: At most 32 pictures or texts a request. The plug-in reads no file of the application and writes nothing. A picture it cannot read, or a model not in its computer's AI catalog, is an error, never a guess.
acceptance: crates/qnc-siglip/examples/look.rs (what one picture shows) and crates/qnc-shot-content-run/examples/look_card.rs (the shot analysis and the content of one original, only read).
